prompts.scene: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square hero illustration placed inside a large circular frame on a camper repair website. Use the supplied image only as a reference for the camper's cream/olive/brown color and clean outlined vehicle style. Green pine forest, a little grass and distant hills behind the camper. Composition designed for a circular crop: all important elements in the central 80 percent, vehicle centered in the upper-middle half and seated people centered in lower-middle half, generous margins at corners, no cut-off faces. Eye-level medium-wide shot, no fisheye. Clean professional Japanese manga book illustration: thin charcoal hand-inked outlines, expressive but restrained realistic adult faces, flat cel shading, clear anatomical hands and limbs, detailed recognizable camper, warm ivory and rich olive green with warm brown accents. Sophisticated editorial manga touch, no chibi, no mascot, no photorealism, no painterly blur, no 3D, no glossy AI sheen, no exaggerated glow. No text, letters, speech bubbles, logos, watermarks, or borders; border and speech bubble will be made in HTML. Opaque background.
